purpose: Close the safe-code gap between second-leg review eligibility and one complete, point-in-time, cost/risk validated V3-B decision path without activating a model, shadow, paper writer or runtime.
required_point_in_time_inputs: canonical candidate_id and Kraken EUR pair
complete fresh 1m/5m/15m closed OHLC, volume, ATR and structure evidence
fresh Kraken online Spot-EUR pair metadata and public minimum-order pass
same candidate, pair and decision clock across assessment and evidence

context_before_action_receipt.change_intent: Implement the missing inactive V3-B full entry decision and execution-risk validation boundary required by the approved V2R4-to-V3 paper transition.
context_before_action_receipt.planned_action: Add one pure offline validator, negative/positive unit tests and this frozen contract; do not touch V2R4 runtime, model, shadow, scheduler or Mini-PC.
superseded_or_rejected_alternatives: Repeat the prior eight-HTTP model batch
Invent a new minimum RR or edge threshold
Activate a V3 shadow or paper writer from CI
context_before_action_receipt.release_gate: Five real VERIFIED_PIT_E2E_PASS artifacts, at least one cost/risk-valid BUY, matched V2R4 control, 6h/24h outcomes, fingerprints, explicit shadow/model-budget gates and physical Mini-PC readiness remain mandatory.
